summary: Agent completed an address change but did not collect the required order ID for full verification and asked for an unnecessary personal detail (phone number). No other policy violations found.

findings.quote: can I have your phone number and email address please
findings.explanation: The agent requested the customer's phone number in addition to email when changing the account address. Per the verification rules, changes to name/address/phone/payment method require full name, account ID and order ID; requesting the phone number is asking for personal data not required for this task.

findings.quote: Ok Your account has been updated.
findings.explanation: The agent confirmed the address change after the account was updated (system turn 19) but the agent never collected the required order ID for full verification. For changes to address, full verification requires full name, account ID and order ID; the transcript shows name and account ID were provided (turns 6–7 and system turn 8) but no order ID was requested or recorded before making the change.
